hw_crooked_witch_hut.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game decoration sprite master for Hagrid Farm. Crisp chunky handcrafted pixel art, cosy spooky wizarding garden, 2:1 dimetric/isometric projection on a 64x32 logical tile. Top-left illumination; selective dark-purple outlines, no pure black/white; clear big pixel clusters, no small noisy texture, no antialiasing, no gradients, no blur. Palette ONLY #231F2E #4A3042 #735044 #A57554 #3E3B70 #6961A6 #70A8B6 #B7DEE0 #874056 #C75B4B #ED8A45 #FFC36B. Use 2-3 of those color ramps per object. Native look must match the rustic pumpkin, broom-rack, mandrake and wooden hut sprites in the conversation reference. TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no scenery, no platform or tile base unless part of the actual subject, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Keep every part including glow as hard-edged pixels. Output ONE wide horizontal sprite master containing exactly TWO separated views of the SAME item: LEFT half default isometric view, RIGHT half the alternate isometric view rotated 90 degrees, NOT a mirror. Both views same size, same baseline near bottom, each fully contained in its own half with generous transparent margins, no overlap. Ground footprints consistent between views. Top-left light stays top-left in BOTH views. This is one asset turnaround sheet, not two different designs.
STRICT TRANSPARENCY: Outside the solid subject EVERY pixel is fully transparent. No soft aura, no vignette, no colored or black background, no cast shadow. Internal light uses hard-edged flat pixel clusters only. Both views fully inside image, consistent ground baseline, generous transparent margins.
SUBJECT: A small cosy one-room witch's hut decoration, weathered timber walls, dramatically crooked violet slate roof with curled chimney, amber arched window, little plank door, pumpkin by doorstep and sparse ivy. No landscape or ground tile, fully visible foundation.
Logical native canvas 192x208 per view. Keep readable chunky shapes suitable for this native size; no fine painterly detail. Same physical item in exactly TWO separate views. Never add people, backdrop or letters.
GRID-FIT REDRAW, reference image is identity/style reference. Replace old native canvas instructions: each view's entire ink silhouette must have width:height approximately 120:145, taller and compact rather than broad. Square 2x2 ground footprint, compact diamond foundation with equal receding edges in 2:1 dimetric projection. Rein in spreading roof eaves and doorstep; no lateral sprawl. Preserve crooked violet roof, curled chimney, timber room, amber window, plank door, pumpkin and sparse ivy. Simplify radically into big chunky pixel clusters legible at 120x145 pixels. LEFT shows front and right wall; RIGHT is actual quarter-turn showing that right wall and rear, with front door hidden around corner, NOT a mirror. Same physical hut, scale and baseline. Wide transparent central gap, all ink safely inside respective halves. Do not draw grid or base platform.
hw_crooked_witch_hut.note: Readable at 120x145. Compact square foundation; alternate shows more side/rear. Final grid placement remains for Claude Code.
